summary: Assess a deployed revision against user outcomes and operational thresholds during a bounded observation window.

inputs.name: deployment-record
inputs.description: Observed deployment identity, revision, environment, and phase.

inputs.name: release-plan
inputs.description: Immutable release identity, target, preconditions, rollout, and recovery controls.

inputs.name: observability-plan
inputs.description: Service indicators, instrumentation, thresholds, and response ownership.

completion_checks: Observations identify the deployed revision, environment, observation window, and baseline.
A verdict separates revision uncertainty, missing signals, functional failures, and threshold violations.
failure_modes: Missing required inputs, capability, or authority: blocked; retain a concrete next action.
Contradictory or insufficient evidence: inconclusive; never report an unobserved outcome as passed.
A demonstrated violation of a required condition: failed; preserve reproducible evidence.
